slice_context.scope: Owning-thread RuntimeBus segment; 8 invariant fields reused; current CPU pointers passed directly each block; SVC rebind

elapsed_audio.debit: Only actual queued PCM; reset on content/restore/reset/output discontinuity; guest clock unchanged

static_operand_predecode.protection: Static ARM operand fields only; runtime register/flags/PC/shift semantics and complete invalidation retained

fixed_width_region_dispatch.protection: Coarse address/profile dispatch with full-width bounds, MMIO priority and original linear fallback
